title: Route each document through the evidence it needs
description: Choose a document family, parsing route, and OCR coverage. The model exposes evidence coverage, latency, and review pressure using illustrative values for architectural comparison.

documents.label: Three-page digital invoice
documents.detail: Strong text layer, dense line-item table, and payment-sensitive totals.
documents.consequence: A misplaced total or currency can authorize the wrong payment. Table structure and reconciliation dominate the route.

documents.label: Twelve-page scanned application
documents.detail: No native text, uneven scan quality, checkboxes, stamps, and short handwriting.
documents.consequence: Skipping image transcription leaves the application effectively empty; handwriting and marks also need a declared fallback.

documents.label: Forty-page scientific report
documents.detail: Native text mixed with two columns, figures, equations, tables, and cross-page sections.
documents.consequence: Plain text extraction can interleave columns and detach captions. Reading order and region identity are the critical evidence.

documents.label: Eight-page digital contract
documents.detail: Reliable text with headings, numbered clauses, signatures, and few tables.
documents.consequence: The native layer is valuable, but clause hierarchy and signature regions still need provenance and structural checks.

routes.label: Native text and geometry
routes.detail: Read embedded spans and coordinates, then apply deterministic order and hierarchy rules.
routes.transcription: Native spans; OCR only on explicitly missing regions
routes.structure: Typed sections and lightweight table reconstruction

routes.label: Native text plus learned layout
routes.detail: Keep trustworthy native spans, render pages for layout, and OCR missing or suspicious regions.
routes.transcription: Native spans with selective OCR fallback
routes.layout: Learned region detection and reading-order reconstruction
routes.structure: Table, list, figure, and section relationships

routes.label: Rendered page and vision first
routes.detail: Render every page, detect visual regions, transcribe them, then reconstruct the document tree.
routes.transcription: OCR or handwriting route across rendered regions
routes.structure: Visual table, form, mark, and hierarchy recovery
